current_role: Governor of Pennsylvania (since January 2023; reelected November 2026)
summary: Josh Shapiro was Pennsylvania attorney general from 2017 to 2023 and has been governor since 2023; he won a second term over Stacy Garrity on November 3, 2026, by roughly 21 points. A business-friendly Democrat backed heavily by Michael Bloomberg, he is widely seen as a 2028 contender though he dismisses the talk.
